important_instructions: The official recruitment notice is TMC/ACAD/186/2026. The notice was issued on 16 November 2026. The recruitment is for Senior Resident in Palliative Medicine. The total number of vacancies is not specified. The interview will be held on 25 November 2026. Interview proceedings are scheduled to begin at 11:00 AM. In-person reporting is from 10:30 AM to 11:00 AM. Hybrid interview participation is available. Hybrid candidates must email their documents by 23 November 2026 at 4:00 PM. Eligible qualifications include MD in Palliative Medicine, Anaesthesiology, General Medicine, Radiation Oncology or Geriatric Medicine, or an equivalent postgraduate degree. The maximum age is 40 years before relaxation. SC/ST candidates receive five years of age relaxation. OBC candidates receive three years of age relaxation. Eligible Persons with Disabilities receive ten years of age relaxation. The monthly consolidated gross remuneration is Rs. 1,33,623. The engagement tenure is up to 31 July 2027. Candidates must produce their resume, photo ID and qualification and experience certificates. No application fee is stated in the official notice. Queries can be sent to the official academic recruitment email.

content_sections.heading: TMC Senior Resident Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Tata Memorial Hospital has invited applications for the position of Senior Resident in the Department of Palliative Medicine. Vacancy Clarification: Notice No. TMC/ACAD/186/2026 does not mention a numerical vacancy count. Candidates should not interpret the single advertised post category as confirmation of exactly one vacancy.

content_sections.heading: TMC Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must be Indian nationals and possess one of the postgraduate medical qualifications prescribed in the official notice. Applicants must have completed a relevant postgraduate medical qualification. The notice does not prescribe a separate minimum number of years of experience or an additional fellowship requirement. Yes. Candidates possessing MD in Anaesthesiology are specifically included among the eligible qualifications for the Palliative Medicine Senior Resident position. Yes. MD General Medicine is an accepted qualification under the official recruitment notice. Yes. Candidates possessing MD in Radiation Oncology can attend the interview, subject to meeting the remaining eligibility conditions. The remuneration table mentions MD/DNB candidates, while the essential qualification section specifies the listed MD specialties or an equivalent postgraduate degree. Candidates holding DNB should confirm whether their particular qualification is accepted as equivalent by Tata Memorial Centre.

content_sections.heading: TMC Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit is 40 years , with relaxation for candidates belonging to the specified categories.

content_sections.heading: TMC Senior Resident Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected Senior Resident candidates will receive a consolidated monthly gross remuneration of Rs. 1,33,623 . Salary Clarification: Rs. 1,33,623 is the consolidated monthly gross remuneration specified in the notice. It should not be represented as guaranteed take-home pay after deductions.

content_sections.heading: TMC Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Tenure
content_sections.text: The recruitment notice specifies that the Senior Resident engagement will continue up to 31 July 2027 .

content_sections.heading: TMC Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The official walk-in interview notice does not mention any application or interview fee. Candidates should follow the instructions in the official notice and contact the academic recruitment office if any clarification is required.

content_sections.heading: TMC Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Tata Memorial Centre will conduct a walk-in interview for eligible candidates seeking the Senior Resident position in Palliative Medicine. The official notice provides two participation modes: In-person walk-in interview at Tata Memorial Hospital, Mumbai. Hybrid interview for candidates who submit the required documents by the specified email deadline. Applicants must present or submit the prescribed qualification and experience records. The notice does not specify a written examination, separate selection-test pattern or interview marking scheme.

content_sections.heading: TMC Senior Resident Walk-in Interview 2026
content_sections.text: The interview will be held on 25 November 2026 at 11:00 AM . Office of the Director (Academics), Homi Bhabha Block, 13th Floor, Tata Memorial Hospital, Parel, Mumbai - 400012, Maharashtra. Candidates attending in person should bring their resume, photo identification and original and attested copies of all qualification and experience certificates.

content_sections.heading: TMC Senior Resident Hybrid Interview 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to participate through hybrid mode must send their CV or resume along with all certificates to the official academic recruitment email. Important: Sending documents by email is the required preliminary step for candidates requesting hybrid participation. The notice does not provide a direct video meeting link or specify whether hybrid participation is automatically approved after document submission. Candidates should follow the instructions communicated by TMC.

content_sections.heading: How to Attend TMC Senior Resident Walk-in Interview 2026?
content_sections.text: Read the official TMC/ACAD/186/2026 recruitment notice. Verify that you possess an accepted postgraduate medical qualification. Check the maximum age limit and applicable relaxation. Prepare an updated resume with academic and professional details. Keep a valid photo identity document ready. Collect original qualification and experience certificates. Prepare attested copies of the relevant certificates. Visit Tata Memorial Hospital, Parel, Mumbai, on 25 November 2026. Report to the Office of the Director (Academics), Homi Bhabha Block, 13th Floor. Complete reporting between 10:30 AM and 11:00 AM. Attend the interview beginning at 11:00 AM. Check the eligibility conditions in the official notice. Prepare an updated CV or resume. Collect the required qualification and other supporting certificates. Email the CV and certificates to [email protected] . Ensure the email reaches the academic recruitment office by 23 November 2026 at 4:00 PM. Follow any interview participation instructions communicated by Tata Memorial Centre. Keep the original documents available if verification is requested.
